motivation.adaptation_basis: Exact intersection of the original eight Branch01 parameters with exact median/lower/upper triplets present in the frozen GWTC-5 Stable Release 9 summary schema.
motivation.not_basis: No O4b summary row value, event/model row value, posterior sample, predictor value, cohort, correlation or p-value was inspected in the formal strict run.

predictor.name: summary_median_max_pair_s90_common5
predictor.per_parameter_aggregation: maximum S90 across the 3 unordered strict-model pairs
predictor.missing_value_rule: Any missing/non-finite required triplet makes the event ineligible; do not derive or impute.

response.name: median_posterior_model_norm_W1_common5
response.normalized_w1: Wasserstein-1 distance divided by average pair IQR scale: (((q75-q25)_a + (q75-q25)_b)/2), with pooled std fallback and floor 1e-12, exactly as Branch01.
response.cells: 3 unordered strict-model pairs × 5 common parameters = 15 cells/event
response.event_aggregation: median of full normalized W1 over the 15 cells
response.posterior_parameter_rule: Each selected event must expose all 5 parameters for all 3 strict models; otherwise protocol HOLD/NO-GO, no model substitution.

eligible_frame.source_class_rule: official categorical O4b BBH frame must be frozen before summary predictor-based selection

cohort_selection.sort: ascending predictor, then event ID lexicographic
cohort_selection.quartile_assignment: For N eligible events sorted as above, zero-based position i gets q=min(3,floor(4*i/N)); q=0..3 maps Q1..Q4.
cohort_selection.within_stratum_selection: Compute SHA256('GWBH-ERIA-COMMON5-v1|'+event_id), sort ascending hexadecimal digest then event ID, select first two in each stratum.

confirmatory_test.one_sided_p_rule: fraction of permuted rho >= observed rho, using all permutations exactly
confirmatory_test.non_support_rule: Preserve as non-support; do not add events, change common parameters, alter models, or change alpha.

branch1_bridge.predictor_recompute_source: Frozen Branch01 SUMMARY_MODEL_SPREAD_PARAMETER_PROFILE.csv restricted to the same common5 parameters.
branch1_bridge.response_recompute_source: Frozen Branch01 cumulative POSTERIOR_MODEL_PAIRWISE.csv restricted to the same common5 parameters and original 8-event holdout.
branch1_bridge.claim: May describe whether the common5 restriction retains the Branch01 association, but cannot upgrade/downgrade the confirmatory status of the original Branch01 test or determine whether O4b is analyzed.

claim_labels.forbidden_positive_claim: Do not call adapted support a strict replication of the original 8-parameter predictor.
